name: GetMoxel
author: getmoxel

sections.description:
Moxel is web analytics for one person running a site. It tells you which page, form or checkout field people give up on, in plain sentences, and says what to change.

  • No cookies and no stored ids. Visitors are told apart for one week with a hash that is then thrown away.
  • Never reads what anyone types. A form field is reported as “filled” or “not filled”.
  • Works with WooCommerce checkout, contact forms and signup forms without extra setup.
  • Three depths. Chill counts visits. Vibey adds clicks, scroll and forms. Feral adds the exact field people leave on.

Paste your site key, pick a depth, and you are done.

External services

This plugin loads the Moxel tracker from https://www.getmoxel.com/m.js on the front end of your site, and that script sends page views, clicks, scroll depth and form events to https://www.getmoxel.com/e. It only runs after you enter a site key.

What is sent: the page path (without the query string), the referring site, screen width, time zone, and the events listed above. Form fields are reported by name only. Typed values, password fields and card fields are never read.

What is never sent: cookies, what anyone typed, email addresses, or anything that follows a person across sites.

Privacy policy: https://www.getmoxel.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings, Moxel.
  3. Paste the site key from your Moxel dashboard and press Save.
  4. Open your site in a private window. The visit shows up in your dashboard within a few seconds.
sections.faq:
Does it count my own visits?

Not by default. Anyone logged in who can edit the site is skipped. Untick the box on the settings page to count them.

Does it work with caching and optimisation plugins?

Yes. The script tag is marked so common optimisation plugins leave it alone.

Can I turn it off on some pages?

Yes, with the moxel_should_track filter. Return false and the tracker is not loaded on that page.
